risks.risk: Mechanical failure of gears or brakes
risks.proof: A video clip of the bike being ridden, shifting through all gears and coming to a complete stop using both brakes.
risks.if_unproven: As non-functional, requiring a full mechanical overhaul.

risks.risk: Structural frame damage (cracks or deep rust)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame welds, the bottom bracket area, and the underside of the tubes.
risks.if_unproven: As a compromised frame with scrap-only value.

risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the teeth on the rear cassette and front chainrings to check for 'shark-finning'.
risks.if_unproven: As heavily worn, requiring immediate replacement of the chain and gears.

risks.proof: A video showing the tires being inflated and holding pressure, with close-ups of the sidewalls to check for dry rot.
risks.if_unproven: As needing immediate replacement of both tires and tubes.

proof_requests: Video of the bike being ridden to demonstrate gear shifting and braking.
Close-up photos of the frame joints and any brand/model decals.
Close-up photo of the rear gear cluster (cassette) and chain.
Confirmation of tire air retention via video.
response.reason: The item is confirmed to be a mountain bike by the witness. It will be priced as a generic, unbranded unit in poor mechanical condition until further proof is provided.
